entities.summary: Odontonema callistachyum, the purple firespike, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is native to Mexico and northern Central America, and has been introduced to Cuba and the Dominican Republic. A perennial shrub, it is typically found in the seasonally dry tropics. It is grown as an outdoor ornamental, and can tolerate shade.
